question: Which country holds the top position in the Global Firepower Index 2025 for military strength?
solution:
The correct answer is __**United States.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The United States has been ranked as the world’s strongest military power in the **Global Firepower Index 2025**, with an unmatched defense budget and advanced military systems.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **With a defense budget exceeding $860 billion, the United States leads globally across land, air, sea, and space military capabilities.**
 
• **The U.S. operates advanced systems, including F-35 fighter jets, nuclear submarines, and space defense programs.**
 
• **Its vast network of military bases globally ensures unmatched reach, cementing its position as a military superpower.**
 
• **Despite competition from other nations like Russia and China, the U.S. remains at the top due to its technological edge and global strategic positioning.**

 __
